instructions.name: cancel_escrow
docs: Buyer cancels and reclaims funds ONLY before the lock_until timestamp.

instructions.name: create_escrow
docs: Buyer deposits USDC into an escrow PDA tied to a specific harvest batch.
Funds are locked until the farmer releases or the buyer cancels (before lock).
PDA seeds: [b"escrow", batch]

instructions.name: create_policy
docs: Farmer creates a parametric insurance policy.
Coverage pays out in USDC when the weather trigger fires.
The farmer's scouting history can reduce the premium rate.
The farmer pays the premium alone; the treasury tops the vault up with
the coverage amount in a separate transfer, so a mobile wallet only
ever needs one signature.
PDA seeds: [b"policy", farm, policy_index (u32 LE)]

instructions.name: delete_farm
docs: Close the farm record and return its rent to the owner.
Ownership is enforced twice over: the PDA seeds bind the farm to the
signing owner, and `has_one` double-checks the stored owner field.
Child accounts — scout reports, harvest batches, policies — are not
touched: their evidence stays on chain as an independent trail, and
every PDA derived from the farm address stays re-derivable after the
account itself is gone.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The owner receives the rent; the PDA seeds bind this signer to the farm.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: Bootstrap the config PDA once. `init` refuses a second call and the
signer must be the hard-coded `ADMIN`; from here on the authority is
account data that `set_roles` can rotate.

accounts.name: initializer
docs: Bootstrap gate: only the hard-coded `ADMIN` may create the config.

instructions.name: register_farm
docs: Create a farm PDA for the signing owner.

instructions.name: release_escrow
docs: Farmer releases the escrow, transferring funds to their wallet.
Only callable by the farmer named on the batch.

instructions.name: revoke_policy
docs: Revoke an active policy before the season ends.
The farmer's premium comes back out of the policy vault, whatever the
treasury funded beyond it returns to the treasury, and both the empty
vault and the policy account close — their rents go back to the farmer.
Revocation is refused once the season is over: from then on the policy
must go through `settle_policy`, so a farmer can never reclaim the
premium to dodge a dry-season payout check.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Program-owned treasury: the sweep-back lands in its canonical USDC
ATA — validated by address, the same check as `settle_policy`.
`[b"treasury"]` under this program, so only the program's own PDA
passes — no state is read from it beyond the address.

accounts.name: insurer_usdc
docs: The treasury's canonical USDC ATA.

instructions.name: reward_report
docs: Transfer SKR tokens from the reward vault to the reporter.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Role gate: only `config.verifier` may pay out rewards.

accounts.name: config
docs: The role lives here — rotating it is `set_roles`, not a redeploy.

accounts.name: reward_mint
docs: Reward SPL mint (e.g. SKR on devnet)

instructions.name: set_roles
docs: Rotate every role in one atomic transaction, signed by the current
admin. This is how authority moves to (for example) a Squads vault:
pass the vault address as the new `admin` — no upgrade, no redeploy.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The current `config.admin` — checked against the stored role below.

accounts.name: config
docs: Seeded, self-referential authority: only the key stored here may
rotate the roles stored here.

instructions.name: settle_policy
docs: Settle a policy against a weather reading.
If rainfall < threshold  → payout fires, farmer receives coverage_usdc.
If rainfall >= threshold → no payout, the treasury reclaims coverage.
In both cases the premium stays in the policy vault.

accounts.name: settler
docs: Role gate: only `config.admin` can trigger settlement.

accounts.name: config
docs: Governance role — who may trigger settlement; the treasury below is
program-owned, so rotating admin moves settlement but not custody.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Program-owned treasury: refunds sweep to its canonical USDC ATA,
whoever `config.admin` happens to be.
`[b"treasury"]` under this program, so only the program's own PDA
passes — no state is read from it beyond the address.

accounts.name: insurer_usdc
docs: The treasury's canonical USDC ATA — validated by address, so the
sweep can only land in program custody.

instructions.name: submit_harvest_batch
docs: Record a harvest batch on-chain. GPS + timestamp prove provenance.
Buyers can inspect the farm's scouting history alongside this record.
PDA seeds: [b"batch", farm, batch_index (u32 LE)]

instructions.name: submit_scout_report
docs: Submit a new scout report (photo hash + GPS + AI label).

instructions.name: submit_weather_reading
docs: An authorised weather oracle posts a rainfall reading for a farm/season.
PDA seeds: [b"weather", farm, season_start (i64 LE)]

accounts.name: authority
docs: Role gate: only `config.oracle` may act as the weather oracle.

accounts.name: config
docs: The role lives here — rotating it is `set_roles`, not a redeploy.

instructions.name: verify_scout_report
docs: Approve or reject a pending scout report.

accounts.name: verifier
docs: Role gate: only `config.verifier` may verify reports.

accounts.name: config
docs: The role lives here — rotating it is `set_roles`, not a redeploy.

accounts.name: farm
docs: Farm must match the report so we can increment verified_report_count

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury
docs: Move accumulated refunds out of the program treasury into the admin's
own USDC account. The treasury PDA signs the transfer, so custody sits
with the program until governance decides otherwise — an EOA admin
today, a Squads vault after `set_roles`.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Role gate: only `config.admin` may move treasury funds.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: `[b"treasury"]` under this program, so only the program's own PDA
passes — no state is read from it beyond the address.

accounts.name: treasury_usdc
docs: The treasury's canonical USDC ATA — the only source funds leave from.

accounts.name: destination_usdc
docs: Withdrawals land in the admin's own USDC account (a vault's, once
`set_roles` points admin at a multisig) — never an arbitrary sink.

types.name: Config
docs: Layer 0 — Program configuration: who may sign which ops gate.
One PDA (`seeds = [b"config"]`) replaces the hard-coded `ADMIN` const as
the source of truth for verify/reward/oracle/settle and for who may
withdraw from the program treasury. Roles are independent pubkeys so they
can be split across keys (or a multisig) without touching the program;
`admin` owns the rotation itself.

fields.name: admin
docs: Governance: rotates every role below (including itself) and the only
key allowed to withdraw from the program treasury.

fields.name: verifier
docs: Verifies scout reports and pays out rewards.
